# Fillcasa

Fillcasa is a Goa real estate website for villas, apartments, condos, luxury rentals and investment properties.

## Main pages
- https://fillcasa.vercel.app/properties
- https://fillcasa.vercel.app/buy
- https://fillcasa.vercel.app/rent
- https://fillcasa.vercel.app/about
- https://fillcasa.vercel.app/blog
- https://fillcasa.vercel.app/contact

## Focus
Goa villas for sale, Goa apartments for sale, Goa condos, entire villas for rent, monthly rentals, beachfront homes, luxury rentals and property investment in Goa.

## Contact
Use the contact form on the website.
